connector_schema_observation.surface: Google Calendar connector schema discovery only; no calendar event was read or mutated.
connector_schema_observation.cleanup_mutation_exposed: update_event can restore a previously read field value; delete_event also exists but was not needed for this candidate.
connector_schema_observation.caller_controlled_operation_identity: A caller-controlled operation key can be encoded in event description or title before update, while the target event_id is server-assigned and must already be known.

hard_gate_results.reason: For an update against a known stable event_id, an ambiguous update response can be reconciled by read_event(event_id) and exact comparison of the caller-controlled operation key/value encoded in the updated field. Repeating the same update is state-idempotent for that field.
A bounded cleanup path exists if the prior field value was read first: update_event can restore that value on the same event_id, and the restored state can be read back by event_id.

The update primitive is addressable only by a pre-existing server-assigned event_id. The caller-controlled operation key embedded in title/description does not itself provide a deterministic server-side lookup namespace for an arbitrary new operation record. Making the candidate self-contained therefore requires pre-provisioning a stable event or invoking create_event; the former is residual pre-existing-resource/user-state dependency, while the latter reintroduces the previously rejected create-event identity/reconciliation problem. Thus this update primitive cannot by itself serve as a generic operation-key server record.

tested_scope: Current Chat-exposed Google Calendar update/read/delete interface contracts only. No external resource mutation, no user calendar data read, no public-web semantics, no historical acceptance import, and no scheduler mutation.
counterexample: A known event_id makes update reconciliation strong, but the server-assigned target identity must exist before the generic operation key. Without a caller-addressable create/provision path, arbitrary operation keys cannot independently name new records; adding pre-provisioning leaves residual dependency and composing with create_event inherits the earlier create-path identity blocker.
